description: Capture confusion moments and cluster them into learning priorities.
notes: Kit fallback inlined; shared kit.js not present at build time — fallback auto-yields if real kit loads

notes.note: A running log of confusion auto-clustered by topic is a nice study ritual, but students don't pay for study rituals — they pay for outcomes. The $6/mo Pro tier (spaced repetition, Anki export) competes with Anki itself, which is free. This is a feature of a learning platform, not a product.
